# RandomOptimizationLandscape

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The energy landscape of optimization problems with random disorder, characterized by many local minima and complex saddle points. Helps predict and mitigate congestion or deadlock states in large-scale topological networks under stochastic traffic.
